messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown in the reference images, using the first reference for the front view and the second reference for the back view. The target outfit consists of the top, the bottoms, and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top, the bottoms, and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in profile, then turns slightly and performs a small dance-like movement, bending the knees and raising the arms before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium shot that slowly zooms out to reveal the character's full body.","clothing":"A yellow patterned cardigan over a yellow shirt, blue leggings, and orange slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Bright blue hair styled in a top bun with a forward-swept fringe.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a medium build and brown skin.","scene":"A cobblestone street in front of a dark storefront with vintage signage reading 'SOAP' and 'COCOA POWDER'."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original white shirt, dark vest, plaid trousers, and dark shoes were replaced with a yellow patterned sweater, blue fitted pants/leggings, and orange slip-on shoes. The character's blue hair, face, body, pose, scene, and camera movement remain largely unchanged.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the character's entire outfit with the reference outfit: yellow patterned sweater/top, blue jeans, and brown lace-up boots, removing all original clothing and footwear while keeping non-clothing attributes unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the blue bottoms are intended jeans or leggings, since the reference shows cuffed jeans while the output appears more fitted
unexpected_changes: Footwear changed to orange slip-on shoes instead of the brown lace-up boots shown in the references
